sentences.en: I detect a hint of ginger in this lemon marmalade.

sentences.en: Bejo makes a ginger coffee in a bronze cup.

sentences.en: Don't forget to bring coriander, chili peppers, and ginger.
sentences.zh: 别忘了带上香菜、辣椒和姜。

senses.zh: 用姜给…调味；使某人有活力
